purpose: estimate cost and effort honestly, with ranges and stated assumptions, so budget decisions are made on realistic numbers
entry_criteria: Scope or requirements exist at some level
Rate and cost information is available
Past delivery data exists or is being gathered
procedure: Break the work into parts small enough to estimate, and list what is excluded.
Estimate each part as a range (best, likely, worst) using past actuals where possible, and note the assumptions.
Add running costs, not only build costs: hosting, licences, support and the team time to operate.
Add a contingency tied to the largest risks, not a flat guess, and show it separately.
Compare the total with the available budget and show what could be cut or deferred to fit.
Re-estimate at agreed checkpoints and report the variance from the first estimate.
acceptance_criteria: Every estimate is a range with stated assumptions
Contingency is linked to named risks
validation_method: FinOps review of the cost model.

validation.check: recompute the totals from the line items in a second spreadsheet or script
check each assumption maps to a line in the risk list or is marked accepted

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A reporting feature is estimated at 40 to 70 person-days with hosting of 300 per month; the contingency of 10 days is tied to the unknown data quality, and the budget fits only if one export format is deferred.
